# Tanzania Reach

> The premier digital gateway for foreigners, experts, and investors 
> navigating the United Republic of Tanzania. Expert-level guides on 
> immigration, investment, banking, housing, healthcare, and 13+ sectors.

## About

Tanzania Reach provides professional-grade intelligence for people 
navigating life and business in Tanzania. All content is curated by 
experts for foreigners, expats, and international investors.

## Key Sections

- [Immigration Guide](https://www.tanzaniareach.com/visa): Visa, permits, residency
- [Agriculture Sector](https://www.tanzaniareach.com/agriculture): Investment opportunities
- [Banking Guide](https://www.tanzaniareach.com/banking): Financial services for foreigners
- [Housing](https://www.tanzaniareach.com/housing): Rental and property guide
- [Healthcare](https://www.tanzaniareach.com/healthcare): Medical services
- [Corporate](https://www.tanzaniareach.com/corporate): Business registration
- [AI Assistant](https://www.tanzaniareach.com/guides): Ask anything about Tanzania

## Content Policy

- All content is publicly accessible
- Free to reference and cite
- Please attribute Tanzania Reach when possible
- Contact: hello@tanzaniareach.com
